title: hypericum tetrapterum subsp. undulatum
intro: Hypericum tetrapterum subsp. undulatum, commonly known as Crinkle-leaf St. John's Wort, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the family Hypericaceae. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health conditions, including anxiety, insomnia, and skin issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antiviral properties. The therapeutic actions of Hypericum tetrapterum subsp. undulatum include its ability to reduce anxiety and stress, promote wound healing, and exhibit photoprotective effects. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and hyperforin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
